tools.name: analyse_aged_debtors_csv
tools.description: Analyse a user-supplied aged-debtors CSV and supplied Bank Rate to return review-only UK B2B chase wording with indicative statutory-interest and fixed-compensation calculations. Returns draft text and structured calculations without storing the CSV or sending messages.

tools.name: get_credit_control_brief
tools.description: Use when someone asks who owes money, which invoices are overdue or which customers need a payment reminder. Return the selected business's overdue totals and up to five customers to check first. Read-only. Uses the latest SHVL import or completed accounting sync and never sends a reminder.

tools.name: get_receivables_health
tools.description: Return a read-only receivables health view for the signed-in SHVL workspace: accounts-receivable balance, overdue ageing, invoices raised this month, receivables payments recorded this month, concentration and 30-day overdue movement where available. This is not a bank balance, cash-flow, profit or

tools.name: search_credit_control_cases
tools.description: Search cases already held in the signed-in SHVL workspace by customer name or invoice reference. Read-only, account-scoped and capped at 20 results.

tools.name: get_credit_control_case
tools.description: Return one case from the signed-in SHVL workspace, including status, payment-readiness state, bounded invoice summaries and communication evidence. Excludes email addresses, message content, provider IDs and payment records.

tools.name: search_xero_invoices
tools.description: Search sales invoices from the signed-in owner’s latest completed SHVL Xero sync by invoice number or customer name. Read-only, capped at 20 and not live Xero state.

tools.name: get_xero_invoice
tools.description: Return one sales invoice from the signed-in owner’s latest completed SHVL Xero sync plus aggregate recorded-payment evidence. Read-only. Excludes Xero IDs, payment IDs, email addresses and message content.

tools.name: search_xero_contacts
tools.description: Search customer contacts from the signed-in owner’s latest completed SHVL Xero sync by name. Read-only, capped at 20 and excludes email addresses, postal addresses and Xero IDs.

tools.name: get_xero_contact
tools.description: Return one customer contact summary and up to 50 sales invoices from the signed-in owner’s latest completed SHVL Xero sync. Read-only. Excludes email addresses, postal addresses and Xero IDs.

tools.name: get_xero_financial_report
tools.description: Read one live Xero Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet or Trial Balance for explicit dates. Capped at 250 stripped rows and never writes to Xero. Requires the matching read-only Xero report permission and a Xero user with Reports access.

tools.name: list_shvl_workspaces
tools.description: List SHVL workspaces available to the signed-in user. If none exist, explain next_step and offer its setup_url or the free summary_url. Connecting an account does not create a workspace. Does not expose customer email addresses or provider identifiers.

tools.name: get_shvl_workspace_status
tools.description: Return the selected SHVL workspace name, entitlement state, connected accounting organisation name and active Xero agent tenant name.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v2" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_credit_control_case, get_xero_invoice, search_xero_contacts, get_xero_contact, list_shvl_workspaces · Private data: get_credit_control_case, search_xero_contacts, get_xero_contact · Public sink: get_credit_control_case, get_xero_invoice, search_xero_contacts, get_xero_contact, list_shvl_workspaces.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_credit_control_case, get_xero_invoice, search_xero_contacts, get_xero_contact, list_shvl_workspaces · Private data: get_credit_control_case, search_xero_contacts, get_xero_contact · Public sink: get_credit_control_case, get_xero_invoice, search_xero_contacts, get_xero_contact, list_shvl_workspaces

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
